newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says Iran, Russia ground test missile.
newsitem.headline: Israel says Iran, Russia ground test missile.

text.p: Israel's air force chief said on Sunday that Iran had ground tested a missile capable of hitting the Jewish state with the help of Russian experts.

"Only two weeks ago the Iranians held a test, albeit only on the ground for the moment, with the Russians for the development of a missile with a range of 1,500 kilometres (950 miles) which could reach from Iran to the state of Israel by means of ballistic missiles," Major General Eitan Ben Eliahu said in remarks broadcast on Israel's army radio.
Ben Eliahu made the comments in a speech at Ramat Gan, a suburb of Tel Aviv.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said after a visit to Moscow in March that Russian President Boris Yeltsin had assured him that "the ballistic missile development..was not taking place and will not take place".

The Los Angeles Times in February quoted Israeli officials as saying Russian transfer of missile technology to Iran included some parts for an SS-4 missile which has a range of 2,000 km (1,250 miles), three times greater than that of any missile now in Tehran's arsenal.
